newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 53,000T of Argentine corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 53,000T of Argentine corn.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Tuesday it has bought 53,000 tonnes of Argentine feed corn at $162.90 per tonne, C&F.
A federation official said the purchase was arranged by the head of the NLCF as he accompanied South Korean President Kim Young-sam on his state visit to Argentina.
Kim is on a tour of Latin America to promote trade and investment.
The arrival of the shipment was set for June 20, to the western port city of Inchon.
Last week, the NLCF bought 209,500 tonnes of Argentine corn.
